goal: Recognizable fish with an organic lofted body and thin fins
geometry_plan: register the image: IMAGE_FRAME = ImageFrame(0.4 mm/px, origin pixel (375, 260) = body centre); camera on -Y
loft elliptical sections on Plane.YZ.offset(x) along X; half-heights from the silhouette, half-widths estimated at about 45% of half-height
tail and dorsal fin: polygons on Plane.XZ extruded symmetrically 2 mm thick, each its own part
trace the eye white, pupil and darker pectoral fin with scripts/trace_regions.py and project them onto the body with img2cad_lib.projected_decal; mirror them to the hidden side
colour each part with the colour sampled from the image and return Compound(children=[...]) so the STEP keeps the colours
